subject: Request: 60-day POC bridge credits for CortexAI
messages:
From: Emma Jones <emma.jones@cortexai.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: 60-day POC extension + credit top-up

Hey Rachel,

Thanks again for the tight timeline during our initial setup — the Redwood team has been great. We ran through the first 2 weeks of the POC and usage is higher than expected due to longer context windows on our agent workflows. We have burned through the standard PLG credit allocation and need a short bridge to complete our integration tests and procurement signoff.

Can Cortex approve a 60-day POC extension plus a one-off credit top-up of $25k (estimated ~10M tokens) while we finalize procurement? Procurement has requested an invoice/commit but their cycle won't close before the end of this month. If we can get the extension and credits, we can demonstrate the final metrics that would justify a committed Dedicated purchase.

Attached: CortexAI_POC_usage_report_20270317.csv (sample usage), SOW draft (for reference).

We can be flexible on a short-term addendum with clear usage caps/audit logs. Appreciate any help getting this routed.

Best,
Emma Jones
Head of Integrations, CortexAI
emma.jones@cortexai.com
+1 415-555-0192

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Emma Jones <emma.jones@cortexai.com>, Peter Holt <peter.holt@cortexai.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: 60-day POC extension + credit top-up

Folks — forwarding CortexAI's ask. Short summary: burned through PLG credits faster than forecast, asking for a 60-day bridge + $25k credit top-up while procurement wraps. Cortex is a likely Dedicated deal (early ARR signal).

Key asks for you:
- Stephanie: can we approve a one-off credit top-up and short extension under an addendum?
- Marcus: what's the hit to forecast / lead scoring and any precedent?
- Dev: any legal/contract concerns for temporary extension (audit logs, data isolation, usage caps)?

They attached usage report + SOW. I think this is high-leverage — if we can demo and get procurement to sign, this converts to a committed Dedicated trial.

Thanks —
Rachel
Rachel Kim
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Mar 2027 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: 60-day POC extension + credit top-up

Thanks for the note, Rachel. Quick take: approve. I recommend we offer a 60-day extension plus a $50k credit top-up instead of $25k — that gives them enough runway to finish integration and shows goodwill. Preconditions:

- Put a usage cap tied to the $50k allocation and auto-throttle beyond that unless a legal addendum/PO is signed.
- Add one metric gate: if Cortex meets the specified latency/availability metric in the SOW by day 45, we expedite procurement support.
- No discounts on list price beyond these credits; this is a consumption credit, not a price reduction.

This has precedent (see DEAL-3902 last year) and converts at a high rate. Marcus — please confirm revenue/regression impact and where we log this in the forecast. Dev — can Legal draft a one-page addendum we can sign quickly?

Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Director, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Emma Jones <emma.jones@cortexai.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Mar 2027 11:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: 60-day POC extension + credit top-up

Looping in legal view. We can do a 60-day bridge + $50k consumption credit conditioned on a signed addendum and these items included:

- Explicit usage cap table (token budget = $50k allocation) and auto-throttle once exhausted.
- Data handling addendum: CortexAI must confirm no retention of Redwood-hosted logs beyond the trial unless mutually agreed; we will enable audit logs for the POC period.
- Liability/indemnity: standard RDW POC cap (no changes to indemnity).
- Termination: credits expire at the end of the 60-day window; any overage billed at standard rate.

I can turn around a one-page addendum template by EOD if this is approved. Need confirmation from Revenue Ops on how we recognize the credit (Marcus).

—Dev
Dev Patel
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Mar 2027 14:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: 60-day POC extension + credit top-up

Numbers checked. $50k credit is acceptable from a revenue ops perspective with the following controls:

- Record credits as a contra-revenue item and tag DEAL-4721-CX in HubSpot.
- Put a hard token cap in the account configuration and mark the billing term as "POC bridge credit."
- Forecast impact: ~($50k) in ARR coverage this quarter; annotate Q2 numbers accordingly.

I have looped in Laura for executive sign-off given the size and precedent. Laura — can we get an approval note back to Cortex with the attached addendum once Dev produces it?

Marcus Lin
Revenue Operations Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Emma Jones <emma.jones@cortexai.com>, Peter Holt <peter.holt@cortexai.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Mar 2027 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Approval: 60-day POC bridge & $50k credit (DEAL-4721-CX)

Approved. Conditions:

1) Dev to produce the one-page addendum and SOW attachment; no lifting of caps until signed.
2) Usage cap enforced by Platform (tokens) + auto-throttle.
3) Credit to be recorded as contra-revenue and tagged in HubSpot (Marcus).
4) Sales to provide a 1-paragraph exec summary of expected conversion and next steps for the renewal meeting.

Rachel/Stephanie — send the approval email and the addendum as soon as Dev has the draft. Emma/Peter — we'll issue the $50k POC consumption credit once the addendum is countersigned; extension window begins on the date of countersignature and lasts 60 days. Looking forward to getting this across the finish line.

Laura Bennett
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
